apps.name: Bifrost Foundation
apps.brief: Bifrost bridge foundation for Business Central
apps.description: Bifrost Foundation exposes Business Central through versioned message types over a CloudEvents-based API, enabling seamless integration and headless operation.

apps.name: Bifrost Language Models
apps.brief: Bifrost Language Models - chat and language models for Business Central
apps.description: Bifrost Language Models: Bifrost Chat, language models, Copilot/OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/Custom LLM/Anthropic/xAI/Google (Gemini) chat providers, MCP tool server and the LLM.Prompt.Complete message type on top of Bifrost Foundation

apps.name: Bifrost Orchestrator
apps.description: Bifrost Orchestrator: scheduled tasks, playbooks and orchestration of Bifrost message types on top of Bifrost Foundation. Provides Job Queue scheduling, monitoring, restart and error handling, and a declarative playbook runner with data flow, foreach iteration and conditional branching.

apps.name: Bifrost Attachments
apps.description: Bifrost Attachments: Azure Blob, Azure File Share and SharePoint storage message types on top of Bifrost Foundation. Gives Business Central and any external caller direct read/write access to cloud storage, chunked uploads and attachment offloading.

apps.name: Bifrost Inventory
apps.brief: Bifrost Inventory - message types for inventory operations
apps.description: Adds Bifrost message types for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central inventory operations that Bifrost Foundation does not cover. Covers item attributes, transfer orders, assembly orders, item tracking, reservations, physical inventory, reclassification journals, item application, inventory periods, cost adjustment and posting to G/L, revaluation, item cost reads and unit price updates - so an agent or integration can run inventory work through one governed API. Each domain can be switched on or off per company, and transfer and assembly posting needs its own permission set.

apps.name: Bifrost Warehouse
apps.brief: Bifrost Warehouse - message types for warehouse operations
apps.description: Adds Bifrost message types for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central warehouse operations that Bifrost Foundation does not cover. Reads bin content and open warehouse activities, and creates, previews and posts warehouse shipments and receipts, creates and registers picks and put-aways - so an agent or integration can run inbound and outbound warehouse work through one governed API. Posting and registering need their own permission set, and invoicing a shipment needs a second one.

apps.name: Bifrost Subscription Billing
apps.brief: Bifrost Subscription Billing - message types for Subscription Billing
apps.description: Adds Bifrost message types for the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Subscription Billing app. Covers subscription lines, customer and vendor contracts, the billing pipeline, price updates and indexation, renewal, usage-based billing, deferrals, contract analysis and migration - so an agent can operate Subscription Billing end to end without manual UI steps.

apps.name: Bifrost Iceland
apps.description: Bifrost Iceland: Icelandic message types (Þjóðskrá/Umsjá, Skatturinn VAT, payroll and capital tax, Seðlabanki rates, Skilagrein, island.is, SMS) on top of Bifrost Foundation.

apps.name: Bifrost Iceland DocEx
apps.brief: Bifröst Ísland DocEx - electronic document exchange
apps.description: Bifrost Iceland DocEx: send and receive Peppol BIS 3.0 e-invoices through Advania and Unimaze, with incoming documents, delivery status and the Peppol code lists, on top of Bifrost Foundation.

apps.name: Bifrost Iceland Treasury
apps.brief: Treasury for Iceland in Business Central: payments, claims, statements and currency rates.
apps.description: Supports the treasury process of Icelandic companies in Business Central, connected to the web services of Icelandic banks and payment providers. Registers domestic and foreign payment batches, creates and follows claims (kröfur) and the payments reported on them, imports bank statements into bank reconciliation and marks payments paid when the statement shows them, and reads currency rates. Payment batches, claims, claim payments and every action at a provider are tracked on read-only pages, the same for every provider, and each payment can carry the Business Central record it pays. Permission sets per treasury domain control who may register payments, manage claims or read statements.
